  • Oversee experiment tracking, registry governance, and reproducibility frameworks to ensure traceability, audit readiness, and alignment to quality standards.
  • Partner with platform, data, and security teams to design robust infrastructure for training and inference (real-time and batch/streaming).
  • Implement observability frameworks to detect drift, performance regressions, and cost anomalies, and lead incident response and continuous improvement cycles.
  • Champion responsible AI practices, addressing issues of data privacy, security, and bias while ensuring alignment to regulatory standards and company policies.
  • Coach, support, and provide mentorship for team members.
  • Stay updated on advancements in AI research, MLOps practices, and AI platform technologies to guide initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; or High School Diploma/General Education Degree and 4+ years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties in lieu of Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that drive measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated understanding of ethical considerations in AI systems.
  • 3+ years of project leadership experience including Agile project management, Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFE).
  • Advanced ability working with machine learning frameworks, programming languages like Python, and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in AI/ML techniques.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise-scale MLOps initiatives.
  • Deep experience with MLflow or equivalent lifecycle platforms (tracking, registry, deployment) and Unity Catalog/feature stores.
  • Expertise in scalable serving patterns (real-time inference, batch/streaming), containerization, and GPU-optimized deployments.
  • Familiarity with GenAI delivery at scale, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt governance, and LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of cost optimization strategies for GPU/LLM workloads (e.g., quantization, batching, autoscaling).
  • Experience implementing observability and SLOs for ML/GenAI systems (drift detection, evaluation gates, incident playbooks).
  • Exposure to governance and compliance practices for ML/GenAI systems, including data lineage, access control, and privacy-by-design.

Formação:

title: Página da Vaga | ANALISTA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS
description:
Job description

A Funcional Health Tech acredita que a saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso, quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias, unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para prover o ecossistema da saúde com soluções que geram eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia.

Aqui, você participará, de maneira direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para os mais diversos serviços de saúde, pois essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, pois isso está em nosso DNA.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Analista de Ciências de Dados será:

  • Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para identificar padrões de comportamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Estruturar hipóteses de negócio e validar estatisticamente seus impactos.
  • Explorar e tratar grandes volumes de dados de saúde, garantindo qualidade e consistência.
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia de dados e visualização de dados para disponibilizar análises e modelos em escala.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações que traduzam resultados complexos em insights claros para áreas de negócio.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos estatísticos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Formação em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise estatística e modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento sólido em estatística aplicada (testes de hipóteses, regressões, modelos probabilísticos);
  • Linguagens de programação: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) e R;
  • SQL para manipulação de bases de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência no setor de saúde será um diferencial (dados de operadoras, indústria farmacêutica ou varejo farmacêutico).
  • Noções de machine learning avançado e técnicas de modelagem preditiva.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git).

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência. Todos os talentos podem participar igualitariamente nos processos seletivos da Funcional. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Product Manager - Sênior (Vender+ B2C)
description:
Estamos em busca de um novo ou nova colega para atuar com foco em Product Manager , dentro do time de Produto. ️

Possuímos mais de 12 mil clientes em todo Brasil e somos um dos líderes de mercado para software de gestão de restaurantes em nuvem! Além disso, somos um dos maiores parceiros integrados ao iFood no Brasil sendo uma das Super Integradoras. Entregamos uma solução completa aos restaurantes do Ponto de Venda à Retaguarda. Demais, né?

E como se não bastasse, recentemente o Ifood também virou nosso investidor, o que significa que vamos acelerar muito nosso crescimento nos próximos meses, e precisamos de alguém para agregar ao time de produto e nos ajudar a fazer a diferença. Você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de produtos que apoiam os restaurantes nas suas operações de atendimento presencial e delivery. É um desafio com alto impacto direto no dia a dia do restaurante, e o objetivo é ajudar os restaurantes a simplificar e agilizar sua operação.

E ai, topa esse desafio?

As responsabilidades neste papel são:

  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio à criação de soluções que geram valor para o cliente final e resultados para a empresa.
  • Definir, priorizar e comunicar os objetivos do produto, compreendendo tendências de mercado e necessidades dos clientes para identificar novas oportunidades;
  • Garantir a execução do roadmap com foco em entrega contínua de valor;
  • Realizar pesquisas, análises de dados e entrevistas para entender a fundo as partes interessadas no produto, buscando entender as dores dos clientes e realizando experimentações para encontrar as melhores soluções (Product Discovery);
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado para identificar novas oportunidades para o negócio.
  • Trabalhar com times de engenharia e design para especificar, priorizar e acompanhar a evolução do produto, garantindo entregas constantes de valor.
  • Acompanhar KPIs e Métricas de iniciativas de produto para garantir o atingimento de resultados esperados pelo negócio.
  • Atuar com o lançamento de novas funcionalidades e produtos, garantindo que os times internos e os clientes estejam preparados para adotar e extrair valor das soluções.

Se você se reconhece nessas características e se identifica com o escopo, confere os requisitos:

  • Experiência com concepção e evolução de produtos digitais.
  • Experiência com produtos voltados ao consumidor final (B2C).
  • Experiência com definição e acompanhamento de métricas de produto orientadas a resultado (como adoção, engajamento, ativação ou retenção).
  • Vivência em processos de product discovery e entrega contínua.
  • Capacidade analítica e orientada a dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, organização e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e capacidade de operar em ciclos curtos com entrega de valor contínua.
  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência com produtos digitais.

Desejável, mas não obrigatório:

  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de CRM, Cardápios Digitais para Food Service ou marketing automation.
  • Experiência em produtos voltados para o setor de food service.
  • Conhecimento sobre frameworks como Shape Up, OKRs, Jobs To Be Done ou similares.
  • Habilidades com ferramentas de métricas de utilização de produtos, como Google Analytics, Pendo, Mixpanel ou Amplitude.

Project Overview

We are hiring one AI / LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. Your primary focus will be building and optimizing RAG models for search across large-scale medical and scientific documents, including pre-processing and embedding over half a billion documents to ensure they are searchable and contextually accurate.   • Conduct hands-on experimentation, model development, and backend engineering with deployments to non-prod environments; collaborate with DevOps for production rollout.
  • Communicate effectively with the team and contribute as an independent contributor as needed.

Requirements

  • Ability to work full-time hours on a contract basis (10AM - 6PM BRT)

  • CLT ONLY ( This cannot change to PJ)

  • Needs to be able to start within 2-3 weeks

  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Atuar como o parceiro estratégico e conselheiro de confiança (trusted advisor) dos nossos clientes, garantindo que eles obtenham o máximo de valor de negócio das soluções Sensedia. A missão do CSM é orquestrar a jornada do cliente de ponta a ponta, impulsionando a adoção, a satisfação e o crescimento para garantir a renovação e maximizar o Net Dollar Retention (NDR).

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Construir e manter um relacionamento profundo com os clientes, entendendo seus objetivos de negócio, KPIs e desafios para desenvolver um plano de sucesso de longo prazo.

  • Orquestração de Soluções: Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da Sensedia, mobilizando e colaborando com os times de Produto, Suporte e Vendas para orquestrar a resolução de desafios e garantir que os esforços internos estejam alinhados às prioridades do cliente.

title: Pre-Award Specialist
description:
Overview

University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

Department: Cancer Center

Working Title: Pre-Award Specialist

Position #: – Requisition #: 37750

Job Summary:

The Oncology Clinical Research Pre Award Specialist is responsible for developing, negotiating, finalizing and reviewing budgets for clinical trials conducted by faculty members of the University of Colorado Cancer Center at University of Colorado Hospital (UCH). This position requires discretion, analytical skill and personal responsibility to identify, research, collaborate and creatively solve problems in a changing environment while remaining within system, institutional, and state fiscal policies. This position works extensively with industry sponsors, CU finance contacts, clinical staff, faculty members, the University of Colorado Hospital, administrative staff throughout the University, as well as representatives from various departments and CU Medicine. A lot of training is provided up front as this position must learn a Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA), oncology clinical trial protocols, and processes and procedures of the oncology clinical trial Post Award specialist, the oncology clinical trial finance/billing specialist, and clinic staff.

Job trainings and functions include reviewing and analyzing complex oncology clinical trial protocols, drafting a study-specific budget to account for all procedural and labor costs, working with the clinical trial system OnCoreTM, calendar builders and Project/Research managers to ensure all costs are properly accounted for. This position is responsible for contracts/ grants solicitation and administration, grant/agreement preparation, review and negotiation, regulatory compliance, sponsor communication and pre-award management. This position will have budgetary oversight and is responsible for the advancement of oncology clinical trial contracts and amendments sponsored by industry, cooperative groups, federal grants/contracts and investigator initiated clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities

Specific Examples of Work Performed (All Levels):

  • Review clinical trial protocols in order to draft a study-specific budget that accounts for all procedural and labor costs.

  • Negotiate budgets with industry sponsors.

  • Review and negotiate contractual payment terms.

  • Work with the Clinical Research Administration Office (CRAO) to review and approve final contracts (budget related sections and exhibits).

  • Work with OnCoreTM calendar builders to ensure financial information in OnCoreTM accurately reflects procedures, rates and prices in the negotiated budgets.

  • Review contractual documents to ensure final negotiated terms have been incorporated.

  • Route contractual documents for non-budget increase amendments.

  • Collaborate with Finance Specialists, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical Coordinators to ensure the negotiated budget terms are understood and billed correctly.

  • Complete pre-award reviews using OnCoreTM and train other finance team members in this task if required.

Additional Duties for Level II:

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Work with Clinical Project Managers and demonstrate advanced research budgeting knowledge.

Additional Duties for Level III:

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in the clinical trials management software OnCoreTM.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget management and negotiation.

  • Train Oncology Clinical Trial Budget Specialist I in budget calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

  • Act as resource to assist other Clinical Research Budget Specialists as needed.

  • Identify process improvement opportunities and involve others across interrelated teams to evaluate.

Work Location

Remote – this role is eligible to work remotely, but the employee must be in the United States.

Why Join Us

The University of Colorado Cancer Center stands at the forefront of cancer research and patient care in Colorado. As the state's only National Cancer Institute (NCI) designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, we hold a prestigious distinction recognizing our contributions to research, clinical trials, prevention, and cancer control. Our guiding vision is to prevent and conquer cancer, together. Our mission is to unite our community to overcome cancer through innovation, discovery, prevention, early detection, multidisciplinary care, and education.

We have more than 300 members, including physicians and researchers, who conduct patient-centered research to develop innovative technologies and treatments. We also employ nearly 300 staff members who help expand the reach of the CU Cancer Center. Our expertise across cancer types enables world-class treatment and hope for patients with difficult cancers.

Why work for the University?

We offer amazing benefits, including generous holiday, vacation and sick leave. The University of Colorado offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical: Multiple plan options

  • Dental: Multiple plan options

  • Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision

  • Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of gross pay

  • Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year

  • Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)

  • Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)

  • Holiday Days: 10/year

  • Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses

  • ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks and programs with CU Advantage.

To see what benefits are available, please visit:

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I (Entry):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist II (Intermediate):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Two (2) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist III (Senior):

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in finance, business administration, healthcare or other related field.

  • Three (3) years of professional experience working in Oncology Clinical Research Finance.

Substitutions for all levels: Related experience in budget, finance, business administration or clinical field may substitute for the degree on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications for Oncology Clinical Trial Pre Award Specialist I:

  • Experience working with clinical trials management software, preferably OnCoreTM

  • One (1) or more years’ experience in a clinical or clinical research setting.

  • Six (6) months or more experience reading and understanding clinical research protocols, specifically oncology, is preferred.

  • Experience managing budgets.

  • Experience with clinical studies calendar specifications and protocol/subject related procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

All Levels:

  • Good comprehension of contract terminology and ability to draft and negotiate contract budget terms.

  • Ability to work across different departments.

  • Organizational skills, ability to multi-task, adapt to change, and handle competing priorities.

  • Financial analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot problems and pursue resolutions.

  • Critical thinking and decision-making with strong attention to detail.

  • Logical thinking with the ability to learn and process large amounts of information.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with medical and clinical research budgeting concepts.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

3. Three to five professional references with contact details

General Description:

The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for driving the company’s sustainability strategy with a strong focus on Scope 3 emissions. This role will identify and mitigate sustainability risks, embed sustainable practices into procurement and supply chain operations, manage sustainability data and reporting, and communicate progress transparently to internal and external stakeholders. The role will report to the Head of Procurement & Sustainability Excellence.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the company’s sustainability strategy with emphasis on Scope 3 emissions reduction, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and values.
  • Manage sustainability budgets, including projects and future financial projections through 2027.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize sustainability risks and opportunities across the value chain; maintain and update climate risk mapping (e.g., Power BI dashboards based on BSI data).
  • Integrate climate-related risks into enterprise risk management (ERM) systems and mitigation plans, and ensure effective tracking and follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain accurate Scope 3 data tables, target-setting frameworks, and emissions footprint repositories.
  • Track and report supplier sustainability data to meet internal needs and external obligations (e.g., sustainability reports, Hong Kong Stock Exchange requirements).
  • Collaborate with sourcing managers (primarily direct, with some indirect) to embed Scope 3 reduction into category strategies, sourcing decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and implement sustainable procurement policies, including ESG sourcing guidance, supplier evaluation criteria, and performance measurement.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives, including climate questionnaires, maturity assessments, outreach, and training sessions, to improve supplier performance on sustainability.
  • Support supplier development programs, including diversity, audits, partnerships, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Educate suppliers and third-party vendors on climate awareness and emissions reduction expectations.
  • Research and evaluate new sustainability technologies and trends (e.g., AI resource use, green chemistry, sustainable construction, and packaging) for business impact and adoption potential.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to procurement leadership and other stakeholders (e.g., PLT updates, ESG sourcing guidance, sustainability reports).
  • Design and deliver internal sustainability education and awareness programs, including recorded webinars and training for procurement teams.
  • Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and responsible procurement due diligence requirements.
  • Build business cases for sustainability initiatives, drive organizational change, and act as a trusted advisor on sustainable business practices.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sustainability management, with proven expertise in Scope 3 emissions.

Other Experience:

  • Strong understanding of sustainability and ESG principles, with practical application in procurement and supply chain.
  • Experience developing and implementing supplier engagement and responsible procurement programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to build compelling business cases.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience preparing clear reports and presentations for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a related regulated sector is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.

N/A

Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.

Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.

  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

The Contract Specialist will provide acquisition support services to the Federal Bureau of Prisons. Each Contract Specialist shall have full authority to act for the contractor on all acquisition matters related to the daily operations of this resulting contract.

Potential sources should include socio-economic program participants (i.e. small businesses, small and disadvantaged businesses, HUB Zone businesses).   • Memorandum, Acquisition Plans, Sole Source Justifications, and other documents common to the acquisition process
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited educational institution and a minimum of five (5) to eight (8) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients. Or at least 24 semester hours in any combination of the following fields: accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics or management.
  • MUST have previous Bureau of Prisons (BOP) experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients.
  • Experienced, skilled, and knowledgeable in all aspects of Federal Government acquisition (i.e. requirements development, budgeting and acquisition planning, market research, development of independent cost estimates.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in contract writing system Unified Financial Management (UFMS) preferred.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting Federal Customers (Department of Justice, DOJ highly preferred).

The salary range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000 per year.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. description:
Overview

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Key Competencies

  • Compliance management and risk control
  • Storytelling and plain language writing
  • Collaboration across sales, delivery, finance, and partners
  • Organization, time management, and follow through
  • High ethical standards and careful handling of sensitive information

Success In The First Ninety Days

description:
Overview

Cargill’s size and scale allows us to make a positive impact in the world. Our purpose is to nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way. Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill. This position is in Cargill’s animal nutrition and health business, where we improve animal lives through better nutrition. Our team researches, innovates and creates solutions that deliver healthy results for our customers.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Dairy Innovation Lead (Open to Remote) will lead the vision of, and champion the product innovation pipeline and commercialization of customer solutions with technical, marketing and commercial leaders within the dairy nutrition and management space. In this role, you will identify and execute business innovation growth projects while leading, prioritizing and reporting on the innovation portfolio. You will provide industry-leading expertise to drive process improvements, and deploy the tools and metrics needed to support them while coaching and executing business innovation strategies.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner collaboratively with relevant stakeholders to build an innovation pipeline aligned with business growth strategies and industry trends.
  • Design and lead innovation projects and independently execute development work, ensuring projects are appropriately resourced and executed.
  • Collaborate with global strategic marketing and technology, research and development and in-market dairy sales and marketing leaders to identify on-farm customer needs to develop new and existing products and solutions.
  • Provide expert thought leadership in the dairy feed and management space, using additional research and interpretation to identify issues or problems.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners across the technical, marketing, commercial, and Innovation teams to drive dairy strategic initiatives.
  • Compile and analyze data for project updates to quantify success and drive accountability. Report on innovation earnings, support business case development, and deliver and manage innovation project technical expenses.
  • Ensure a safe working environment and compliance of animal welfare and product safety.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a field related to animal nutrition or animal science
  • Minimum requirement of six years of relevant work experience
  • Industry experience in dairy, feed, animal nutrition, or agriculture
  • Practical experience in basic animal nutrition, physiology and health expertise
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a field related to animal nutrition or animal science
  • Research skills
  • Experience in digital, automation and/or artificial intelligence
  • Customer-facing technical service experience
  • Project management experience
  • Experience leading non-core innovation originating from customer discovery

Applicant Information

The expected salary for this position is $130,000 to 180,000. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific location, certifications, education, and level of experience. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. This position is eligible for a discretionary incentive award. The incentive award amount is dependent upon company performance and your personal performance.

title: Senior Qa Engineer (Sql)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior QA Engineer with 7+ years of QA experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases, and performing application regression testing. This key individual should have confidence in making decisions, as well as working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today, processing $5 billion in daily sales.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements for new features and enhancements to effectively define, execute, and analyze test plans, cases, and coverage
  • Configure test environments (desktop, SaaS, and mobile) to execute required test cases to validate product releases
  • Find, isolate, document, regress, and track bugs through resolution
  • Review the product user interface for conformity to design guidelines
  • Define and implement metrics to determine test effectiveness, efficiency, and overall product quality, including identification of under-tested components
  • Measure escaped defects (quantity and severity) that reach production; analyze test logs, create test reports, and perform root cause analysis of issues
  • Participate in review meetings to share test case status, discuss concerns and risk items, drive comprehensive test coverage, and advocate for quality in every phase of the development process
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in systems, tools, and processes, as well as drive those improvements to effective adoption

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of software testing experience, including functional, bug verification, regression, user acceptance, and user experience testing
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Knowledge of test case management tools, such as JIRA / Xray
  • Solid SQL skills and familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Varied environment and delivery modality experience, including desktop, SaaS, and mobile, as well as experience working with Microsoft Azure
  • Extensive knowledge of software, database, and integration testing, including end-to-end test verification across applications / products
  • Interpersonal skills with the ability to empower others and collaborate with peers and stakeholders
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Automated testing experience with Playwright (or other tools) or desire to learn
  • API testing experience with Postman
  • Familiarity with restaurant or retail order processing, payment processing, and restaurant management

Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start : ASAP

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados [Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas negras]
description:
Pessoa Especialista de Dados (Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas negras)

Job type: Full-time employee

Você quer trabalhar em um lugar que está transformando a educação pública do Brasil? Se imagina em um ambiente colaborativo , inovador e com um propósito que importa ? Quer fazer parte de um time que valoriza a diversidade , promove a inclusão e acredita na potência de cada pessoa?

Se respondeu sim para tudo isso, essa oportunidade é pra VOCÊ!

A Nova Escola é uma organização sem fins lucrativos e a marca mais reconhecida por educadoras e educadores da Educação Básica no Brasil. Nossa missão é fortalecer professores e professoras para transformar a educação pública e garantir que cada estudante desenvolva seu máximo potencial.

Somos mantidos pela Fundação Lemann e contamos com o apoio de parceiros como B3 Social, Microsoft, HP, Meta, Internet Society Foundation e Imaginable Futures . Essas parcerias nos ajudam e impulsionam nesse desafio de transformar a educação pública através dos educadores, promovendo ações que os apoiem a desenvolverem suas práticas, terem os melhores recursos e se informarem.

Sobre a área de Dados

A área de Dados da Nova Escola atua para organizar, analisar e disponibilizar dados que apoiem a tomada de decisões em toda a organização, com foco em aprimorar nossos processos e produtos e ampliar nosso impacto na Educação Básica. Nosso time é responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a coleta e modelagem até a construção de análises, relatórios e dashboards, garantindo que diferentes áreas tenham acesso a informações confiáveis, úteis e acionáveis.

Trabalhamos em parceria com diferentes times, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e acessibilidade dos dados, e promovendo uma cultura orientada por evidências.

SUAS PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES SERÃO:

  • Trabalhar com bases de dados grandes e complexas, realizando a captura, manipulação e análise dessas informações
  • Conduzir todo o ciclo de análise de dados, da definição de requisitos à coleta, processamento, modelagem, visualização e apresentação de resultados
  • Criar e manter dashboards, relatórios e análises que apoiem a tomada de decisões e o acompanhamento dos objetivos estratégicos
  • Resolver problemas complexos e não triviais, como identificar padrões de comportamento de uso em produtos da Nova Escola, aplicando métodos analíticos avançados quando necessário
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e o monitoramento de métricas para gerar aprendizados e insights relevantes para a organização
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas como Produto, Tecnologia, UX, Marketing, Conteúdo, Parcerias e Liderança para entender demandas, apoiar a disponibilização de dados, aprimorar análises existentes e contribuir na avaliação de resultados
  • Fazer recomendações baseadas em dados, como análises de comportamento de usuários, apoio na definição de metas organizacionais e OKRs dos squads, além do desdobramento e monitoramento dessas metas
  • Atuar como embaixador(a) da cultura orientada por dados, contribuindo para autonomia dos times e fortalecendo esse valor na Nova Escola

Para trabalhar na área de Dados, procuramos pessoas com:

  • Formação ou experiência consolidada em áreas quantitativas, com domínio de conceitos analíticos, estatísticos e computacionais
  • Experiência prática com análise de dados em contextos reais, com atuação em exploração de grandes bases, geração de insights e apoio à tomada de decisão
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, com capacidade de explorar bases complexas e responder questões analíticas de forma eficiente
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e ambientes em nuvem, especialmente AWS (por exemplo: Athena, S3, Glue, QuickSight)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia em todo o ciclo de análise: desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega e comunicação dos resultados
  • Conhecimento para trabalhar com Python para análise de dados e automações
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (QuickSight, Looker, Power BI)
  • Clareza para traduzir dados em hipóteses, descobertas e recomendações compreensíveis por diferentes públicos.

Caso você cumpra a maioria, mas não todos os requisitos para a vaga, não deixe de se candidatar. Podemos conversar para te conhecer melhor e entender se conseguimos te apoiar nas aprendizagens necessárias!

Será um diferencial se você também tiver:

  • Familiaridade com aplicações práticas de inteligência artificial e machine learning, especialmente em contextos de produto (ex: recomendação, personalização, geração de conteúdo, segmentação de usuários)
  • Visão estratégica para transformar análises em recomendações de negócio, conectando dados a decisões sobre produto, metas e experiência do usuário
  • Maturidade analítica para escolher abordagens e ferramentas adequadas a cada contexto, sabendo equilibrar complexidade, tempo e impacto nas análises
  • Interesse por Educação Básica pública e vontade de trabalhar com impacto social

Para o seu bolso e rotina

  • CLT com horário flexível
  • Participação nos Resultados (até 2 salários!)
  • Vale-refeição de R$39,71/dia útil no cartão Flash
  • Auxílio home office mensal
  • Auxílio creche para crianças até 7 anos

️Para sua saúde e bem-estar

  • Plano de saúde Amil (apartamento) com 50% para dependentes
  • Wellhub (Gympass) com acesso a academias, apps de meditação e bem-estar
  • Licenças estendidas de maternidade e paternidade

Para seu desenvolvimento

  • Apoio financeiro para cursos e formações
  • Desconto em escolas de inglês
  • Participação em eventos e trilhas de aprendizagem internas

Para recarregar as energias

  • Day off no aniversário
  • Recesso coletivo de fim de ano (10 dias de descanso garantido)

Faça parte do time que está transformando a Educação pública do país!

  • Step 3: Entrevista com Gente&Gestão
  • Step 4: Entrevista Técnica com Pares

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimora nossos processos.

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. If you receive suspicious requests or communications, please report them All of our legitimate openings can be found on the Personify HealthCareer Site.

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain’s growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI / CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container / Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React / React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2 / OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI / CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM / AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain’s growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture.

This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI / CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container / Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React / React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2 / OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI / CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM / AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

Who We Are

Rain is filled with people with a deeply rooted passion for our mission, who embrace diversity throughout our global team, and grow personally and professionally. We own what we do and let data guide our actions while working quickly and adapting to new challenges everyday.

You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. description:
Join to apply for the Grupo QuintoAndar | Staff Data Scientist role at QuintoAndar

About Grupo QuintoAndar: We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year. Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit:

Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

Hiring Process Stages
The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • Interview with Recruiter
  • Tech Screening
  • Technical Interview with Data Products Team
  • Offer

About the Area
In our Data Science team, you'll have the chance to work as a part of our product squads delivering features that enrich our product and a first class experience that we are known for. You'll work alongside brilliant minds, with different skills: Product Managers, Designers, UX Writers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers, etc. Be prepared for the job of your life - hard challenges, high expectations, intelligent life at work, meaningful conversations, outstanding productivity.

Some of the specific problems we work on in the Data Science team include search and recommendation systems; customer experience enhancement using ML such as automatic routing of tickets; pricing, liquidity and credit models; building a platform that enables us to develop and deploy all those solutions.

Note: This is a senior position. We expect you to have at least 3+ years of experience applying data science and creating machine learning models. If you have the skills, but are starting your journey in Data Science, please apply to the Data Scientist job instead.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop and deploy machine learning systems to production. The main use cases are related to chatbots and search.
  • Design and execute experiments.
  • Analyze a wide variety of data (structured and unstructured, observational and experimental) to improve current models or create new ones
  • Apply the scientific method to develop LLM-powered applications, including testing different prompts, exploring and understanding LLM capabilities, evaluating agents and prompts, assessing AI application guardrails, and building PoCs to validate the feasibility of generative AI for product features.
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions regarding the whole Data Science chapter (Guilds, Design Reviews, Demos, etc.)

What we are looking for:

  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through Data Science
  • Expert knowledge of machine learning concepts: regression and classification, clustering, neural networks, feature selection, cross-validation, curse of dimensionality, bias-variance tradeoff, model explainability, etc.
  • Good understanding of the engineering challenges to deploy machine learning systems to production
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Some knowledge or experience with Deep Learning
  • Experience with technical advice for other data scientists (technical leadership)
  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills. We're looking for someone who loves Data Science & Machine Learning and is willing to share his/her knowledge with the other members of the Data Science Chapter
  • Good English skills (verbal and written) is mandatory

You’ll stand out if you:

  • Have a MSc. (or Undergrad + intense experience) in machine learning, data science, information retrieval, ranking systems, recommender systems, natural language processing or other relevant fields
  • Have experience with applied generative AI: AI agents, prompt engineering, LLMs finetuning (lora, qlora, peft), LLM routing, LLM monitoring, LLM guardrails
  • Have experience working at fast-growing startups

Important

  • Our hiring process starts with the application. If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.
  • All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

  • Profit sharing
  • Meal allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy
  • Wellhub

  • Extended parental leave
  • Day off on birthday, Mother's Day, and Father's Day
  • Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)

  • Reading kit for children – PlayKids

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar
We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

Job description

Na Netshow.me, ser Gerente/Head de Pessoas e Cultura é ser responsável por definir e executar a estratégia de gestão de pessoas e cultura organizacional, garantindo que a empresa seja um ambiente de alto desempenho, colaborativo e inclusivo. Este cargo combina liderança estratégica com atuação prática no dia a dia, sendo referência para a equipe de Pessoas e Cultura e parceira das lideranças em todos os assuntos relacionados a talento, desenvolvimento, engajamento e clima organizacional. Nessa posição, a pessoa Gerente/Head de Pessoas e Cultura participa ativamente de projetos, desenha processos, testa soluções e garante que as iniciativas de RH gerem impacto real. É responsável por liderar a equipe de People, implementar programas de desenvolvimento, engajamento e reconhecimento, e apoiar as lideranças na resolução de desafios operacionais e estratégicos do dia a dia. O cargo exige visão estratégica aliada à execução prática: tomar decisões baseadas em dados, propor soluções inovadoras, influenciar positivamente a cultura da empresa e garantir que as políticas e programas de RH realmente funcionem para as pessoas.

TRABALHAR NO TIME DE PEOPLE

O time de People and Culture da Netshow.me tem um propósito muito inspirador: nós existimos para ajudar as pessoas a alcançarem o seu melhor potencial, enquanto trabalham em uma empresa incrível. Nosso trabalho é zelar pelo desenvolvimento, bem-estar e satisfação de cada Netshowmer, fazendo com que todos se sintam valorizados e parte de uma equipe que busca sempre o sucesso conjunto. Nosso foco principal são as pessoas, por isso investimos em atração e retenção de talentos, proporcionamos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, acolhedor e com um propósito claro, para que todos tenham orgulho de pertencer à Netshow.me. Além disso, a nossa área é responsável por dar suporte à liderança e cuidamos de questões relacionadas à cultura, comunicação interna, plano de carreira, cargos e salários, eventos, comemorações e toda sua jornada como Netshowmer. Estamos aqui para garantir a qualidade de nossos valores em todas as relações humanas. Juntos, vamos construir uma empresa ainda mais forte e uma cultura ainda mais inspiradora!

  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de People e Culture, equilibrando direção estratégica e atuação operacional;

  • Atuar na resolução de conflitos e questões de relações de trabalho, garantindo soluções ágeis e efetivas;
  • Garantir a conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e regulamentações relevantes;
  • Fornecer orientação estratégica para programas de recompensas e benefícios;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e melhores práticas em gestão de pessoas e cultura.
